headline: Desired capacity cannot be lower than minimum size; this configuration will be ignored and capacity will remain at 3 instances.
suppressed: The goal of cost savings overnight is sound, but the implementation needs either min_size reduced to 1 or a scheduled action to temporarily adjust these values during off-peak hours.

findings.evidence_ref: desired_capacity = 1 with min_size = 3 in the same resource
findings.explanation: AWS Auto Scaling Groups enforce that desired_capacity must be between min_size and max_size. This change will have no effect; the ASG will ignore the desired_capacity of 1 and immediately scale to 3 instances to meet the minimum requirement, negating the cost savings goal.
